{{RemovedSandboxOnly|date=29th of October 2020}} {{for|other uses of [[Gold (Disambiguation)|Gold]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Golden |image1 = Golden.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via:
[[Golden Mode|{{Color|GoldenMode}}]] |first_wave_appearance = 20 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]200 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4) |cash = {{Money|5}} on death |spawned_by = *[[Mystery]] (Golden, wave 21 onwards) *[[Uber Mystery]] (Formerly) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Splash}} }} {{QuoteContainer|{{QuoteBox|Explosions wont help you anymore.|Beginning of Wave 20 ([[Golden Mode|Golden]])}}}} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Golden''' is a golden [[Enemies|enemy]], as the name suggests. It has an above average speed while having slightly more health than the [[Abnormal Boss]]. Uniquely, it is immune to [[Splash Damage|splash damage]]. This meant that the [[Rocketeer]], [[Mortar]] and [[Demoman]] were useless against this. The [[Mystery]] has a chance to spawn the '''Golden''' upon its death in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, wave 21 onwards. It was also spawned by the [[Gold Titan]], though this no longer happens in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Appearance== The '''Golden''' has no face and the [[Enemies|enemy]] was colored gold from the head to the legs. Its torso and legs are a darker shade of gold compared to its arms and head. ==Strategy== *Splash damage towers are practically useless against this, [[24 Karat]]s, [[Gold Guard]]s and the [[Gold Titan]] as they all have immunity to splash damage. **It is best to limit the amount of [[Rocketeer]]s or [[Demoman|Demomen]] you place down. This does not necessarily mean that they are overall useless since they are very effective against the [[Summoner Boss]]. **Despite the fact that the [[Commando]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Military Base]] deal splash damage, they are still quite effective against the '''Golden''' due to the fact that they deal non-splash damage. *Due to the fact that '''Goldens''' have [[Splash Damage Immunity]], you must take them down one by one with high DPS towers such as the [[Turret]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Ranger|Outlaw]]. *The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Pyromancer]] can be used to slow groups of these down. **The [[Freezer]]'s basic freeze cannot freeze '''Goldens''', but the [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Age'' ability can freeze it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} GoldenPreOverhaul.png|First version, first animation (2 August 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseGolden.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} GoldTitan.jpg|'''Golden''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} PromoArt0.png|'''Golden''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} PromoArt2.png|'''Golden''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer|'''Golden''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} OldEnemiesLeak.png|'''Golden''' on a development image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} GildedPathTrivia2.png|Dead '''Goldens''' in [[Legacy Gilded Path]]. GoldenIconIG.png|'''Golden''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *When the [[Uber Mystery]] was in the game, it had a chance of spawning the '''Golden''' upon its death in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. *Multiple dead '''Goldens''' can be seen laying on the ground in [[Gilded Path]]. ==Update History== *'''2 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.7|BETA v1.7.0]] **'''Golden''' added. *'''15 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.10|BETA v1.10.0]] **First wave appearance changed from wave 56 to wave 58. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Golden''' health decreased from 1,000 to 200. **'''Golden''' moved from wave 56 to wave 20 of Hard mode (now [[Golden Mode|Golden]] Mode). **Speed increased from Slow to Above Average (4). *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0]] **'''Golden''' removed. *'''17 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.4]] **'''Golden''' now appears in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, if activated through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''17 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.5]] **'''Golden''' no longer appears in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, as it has been removed. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0|v1.53.3a]] **'''Golden''' now appears in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, if activated through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{Golden|[[Mystery]]|Wave 16|Golden|Wave 20|[[Chained Boss]]|Wave 22}} {{Hard|[[Rusted]]|Wave 56|Golden|Wave 58|[[24 Karat]]|Wave 59}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
